panel.title: Review analytics
panel.description: Review metrics for the period: trend, regions, ratings
panel.info: All metrics count reviews published in the selected period within the global scope and filters. Comparing periods adds a delta to the cards.

locations.title: Location ranking
locations.description: Locations by review count, rating and reply share
locations.info: Click a name to open the location card. Sort by clicking a column header.

cities.title: City ranking
cities.description: Cities by review count and average rating
cities.info: The city comes from the location address.

tags.title: Tag ranking
tags.description: Tags the team applies to reviews
tags.info: A review with several tags counts in each of them.

phrases.title: Frequent phrases
phrases.description: Phrases that appear most often in review texts
phrases.info: Click a phrase to open the concordance — its context in reviews.

staff.title: Staff
staff.description: Replies and reaction speed per team member
staff.info: Published replies in the period are counted; the average time is from review publication to the reply.

topics.title: Topics
topics.description: Aspects customers write about, with sentiment
topics.info: Topics are extracted by the AI from the review text; sentiment follows the rating and content.

concordance.title: Concordance
concordance.description: Keyword in the context of reviews
concordance.info: Enter a word or phrase — the table shows review fragments containing it. Click a row to open the review.

negative.title: Locations with the most negativity
negative.description: Most reviews rated 1–2 in the period
negative.empty: No negative reviews in the period

concordance.emptyHint: We will show review fragments containing it, with rating and platform
concordance.nothing: «{keyword}» does not occur in reviews for the period
concordance.nothingHint: Try another word or widen the period
